findings: Coinbase Q3 2026 10-Q reports one unnamed counterparty at 27% of Q3 revenue and 25% of nine-month revenue; do not attribute it to Circle or Ripple.
Coinbase generated 84% of Q3 revenue in the U.S.; no other country exceeded 10%; stablecoin revenue is substantially all U.S.-attributed.
Coinbase Q3 transaction revenue fell 44% YoY; consumer spot volume fell 59%, institutional spot volume 53%; derivatives and prediction markets partly offset.
Circle Q2 2026 10-Q reports USD123.2M access-denied USDC tokens, excluded from circulation, with associated reserves segregated and liability retained until legal transfer or reversal.
Approximately 84% of Circle's USDC reserves were held in a BlackRock-managed Rule 2a-7 government money-market fund; remaining cash was distributed across banks, with limited FDIC coverage.
